scene_description: Topic and angle ideation for short videos under three minutes. Produces video topics that can be explained within the duration, have a hook in the first three seconds, and match the account's persona.

questions.question: What is the account's positioning or niche? (e.g. student knowledge content, workplace tips, dorm comedy)
Which platform do you mainly publish on?
How long is a single video?
What stage is the account at?
What type of hook do you prefer?
What is the main goal at this stage?
Which topics or red lines must you stay away from?

skip_logic.description: Adjust the topic based on platform, duration, account stage and goal.
rules: If the user picks "zero followers, cold start", do not ask for audience-profile details; prefer low-barrier, high-relativeness topics that can ride platform trends
If the user picks "under 30 seconds", give one information point per topic; no multi-point or multi-step content
If the platform is "Xiaohongshu", prefer filmed / image-text formats, switch the title and cover to Xiaohongshu style, and add hashtag suggestions
If the goal is "product sales", ask about the product and add advertising-law and platform e-commerce compliance notes to the risk warnings
If the platform is "Bilibili" and the length is "over 3 minutes", the topic can be a deep argument and the hook can open with an opinion or a story

tone_examples: Good: You know that thing I spent three weeks figuring out? I will explain it to you in one minute today.
Good: Do not take notes yet, 90% of people get the first step of this method wrong.
Bad: Herein lies a video that aims to expound several issues to all of you.
Bad: Group X just sucks, people like that deserve it. (provocation, discrimination, personal attack)
conditional_notes: When the account is "tips / educational", keep the colloquial tone but raise the information density; jokes must not overshadow the content.
Opinions can be sharp, but no provocation, discrimination, rumors, or platform-rule violations.

constraint_list: The topic must explain a single point within the target duration
The first 3 seconds must have a clear hook, and the hook copy must be written into the topic
One video expresses one core message; no multi-theme stacking
The topic must match the account's positioning and persona
It must be producible with existing equipment and people (cold start defaults to one person with one phone)
Opinions must follow platform rules and the law
exclusion_rules: Topics the platform flags as sensitive, rule-breaking or provocative
Trends force-fitted to the account's niche
Shoots needing a team, props or budget the user does not have
Complex arguments that cannot be finished in the duration
Rewrites, reposts or remakes of others' content
False advertising or exaggerated claims, especially in product sales content
